article.story: WEST LAFAYETTE, Ind. -- — Reserve guard Luke Ertel scored 24 points, all on 3-pointers, Purdue buried a school-record 21 3s and the Boilermakers raced past Oakland 95-49 on Friday night. Ertel, a freshman who hadn't made more than one 3 in any of his five previous games, made 8 of 10 from distance. The Purdue individual record is nine 3-pointers, held by Carsen Edwards and Mason Gillis. Daniel Jacobsen had 16 points and nine rebounds for Purdue (4-2). Caden Pierce scored 13 points and Gicarri Harris 11. Chris Fields Jr. had 18 points, 10 rebounds and five steals for the Golden Grizzlies (1-7). Purdue made 9 of 20 3-pointers in the first half, including 4 of 5 by Ertel. A pair of 9-0 runs helped the Boilermakers take a 47-17 lead at halftime. Purdue shot 53% from the field and held Oakland to 20% before the intermission. The Boilermakers scored 24 points on a series of eight made 3-pointers in 14 attempts that extended their lead from 34 points to 51 points in the middle of the second half. Eleven of Purdue's last 13 made shots were 3-pointers. Purdue wrapped up a five-game homestand and will play only two home games in the next 39 days. Up next Purdue: The Boilermakers play DePaul on Tuesday at the Fort Myers Tip-Off. Oakland: The Golden Grizzlies visit Houston on Nov. 27. -------- Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
